problems.title: UB or not?
problems.solution: Signed overflow, oversized shifts and aliasing violations are UB; unsigned wrap is defined.

problems.title: Container choice

parts.prompt: Ordered keys with range queries (all keys between a and b):

problems.solution: vector for scans; map's ordering supports lower_bound ranges.

problems.title: Vanishing check

parts.prompt: Why can Clang at -O2 return false for add_overflows(INT_MAX, 1)?
options: signed overflow is UB, so the compiler may assume a + b can't wrap and fold the comparisons
__builtin_add_overflow or test against INT_MAX − b before adding

problems.solution: Use a precondition test or the builtin; widening works too when a wider type exists.

problems.title: Spin wait
problems.statement: bool ready = false; set by thread A; thread B runs while (!ready) {}.

options: the loop never ends: the load is hoisted (data race = UB)

problems.solution: volatile doesn't give inter-thread ordering in C++. Use atomics (Part 10).

problems.title: Growth
problems.statement: push_back 10⁶ ints into an empty vector with growth factor 2.

parts.prompt: Total elements copied/moved during growth (< 2n, millions)?

problems.solution: About 20 reallocations; 1 + 2 + 4 + … + 2¹⁹ ≈ 10⁶ moves in total, amortised O(1) per push.

problems.title: Padding
problems.statement: struct A { char c; double d; int i; }; on x86-64.

parts.prompt: sizeof after reordering to {double d; int i; char c;}?

problems.title: Unsigned loop

options: i >= 0 is always true for size_t: the loop never ends
v.size() − 1 underflows to SIZE_MAX if v is empty

problems.solution: Use for (size_t i = v.size(); i-- > 0;) or reverse iterators.
